rationale: With only 4 minutes to close, any position opened now faces forced market liquidation at the bell, creating unacceptable slippage risk on a stock that has already dropped ~14% today with high relative volume and no news catalyst to anchor direction. The last few candles show a sharp drop from $15.41 to $15.19 with no clear stabilization pattern, and the extremely wide intraday range ($14.20–$17.50) makes reliable stop placement nearly impossible within the remaining time window. Risk/reward does not justify entry at this stage of the session.
